name: The Plaza Hotel New York
positioning: The Plaza, a Fairmont hotel, at the corner of Fifth Avenue and Central Park South, with themed suites such as the Eloise and Gatsby suites
best_for: Travelers who want a Fifth Avenue base beside Central Park
Guests who like themed suites and afternoon tea

facts.text: The Plaza stands at the corner of Fifth Avenue and Central Park South.
The hotel describes its Fifth Avenue location as close to Central Park, Bergdorf Goodman, Museum Mile and Carnegie Hall.
The Tower Room is on the 18th floor, overlooks Fifth Avenue and has a large round bed under an exposed brick turret ceiling.
The Eloise suite is themed in pink and white and comes with Eloise bedding, a tea set and Eloise and Weenie dolls.
The Gatsby Suite is a junior suite with Art Deco decor, dome ceilings, antique mirrors and glass chandeliers.
The Palm Court serves tea with a Palais des Thés tea collection, sandwiches and fine pastries.
The Palm Court has a stained-glass ceiling.
The Champagne Bar serves champagne, caviar and wines.
The hotel has a 111SKIN SPA/CLINIC that offers skincare.
The fitness center is on the 4th floor.
Each child receives a Plaza Passport at check-in.
The hotel says it was the first hotel in New York to permit pets.

The hotel's parking facility is off-site.
WhataHotel notes a busy Midtown location with high foot traffic.
